tests.name: Reject Duplicate Player Join
tests.why: Ensures that a player already in the lobby cannot join the same game a second time; the spec requires a 400 error for this specific scenario.

tests.name: Reject Ship Placement After Game Starts
tests.why: Once the game state transitions to 'playing', the server must reject further ship placement attempts with a 409 conflict.

tests.name: Verify Move History Integrity
tests.why: Confirms that the move history endpoint returns a valid object and an array of moves once gameplay has begun.

tests.name: Enforce Strict Turn Order
tests.why: Ensures the server returns 403 Forbidden if Player 2 attempts to fire before Player 1 has taken their initial turn.

tests.name: Validate Player Stats in Active Session
tests.why: Verifies that player statistics can be retrieved and contain the correct snake_case fields even while a game is currently in progress.
